description: Get the Verdict rating for one DeFi entity: letter grade, composite score 0-100, and public metadata. Identify it by slug (e.g. 'aave-v4') or UUID. Keyless. For the per-domain scores behind the grade, use get_rating_breakdown. Example: get_rating({ entity_type: 'protocol', identifier: 'aave-v4' }).

entity_type.description: The kind of entity: protocol, chain, token, oracle, vault, organisation, or bridge.

identifier.description: The entity's slug (e.g. 'aave-v4' or 'ethereum') or UUID.

name: get_rating
title: Get a Verdict rating
